initialize.instructions:
RuneLite game client control. Prefer the one-call interaction tools over screenshots and raw clicks:
- inventory item (drop/eat/wield/use): item_action - NEVER screenshot or click_component for this
- scene object (chop/mine/open/bank): interact_object
- NPC: interact_npc, or get_npc_menu + click_menu_option for server-added options
- other player (trade/follow): interact_player
- widget right-click option: widget_action
Data tools (list_*, get_*, dump_interface) answer questions about game state - use them instead of screenshots.
To wait for something to finish (walking somewhere, combat, an interface opening, a game message), call wait_for - never poll with screenshots or repeated list calls.
Only call screenshot when the user explicitly asks to SEE something or for visual layout verification.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG of the game canvas. No args = full canvas. Crop with componentId (single widget), interfaceId (whole interface, tight), or x/y/width/height (region).

componentId.description: Packed component id to crop to (interfaceId << 16 | childId)

childIndex.description: Dynamic child index of componentId to crop to

interfaceId.description: Interface (group) id to crop to: union of its visible component bounds

padding.description: Extra pixels around the widget/interface crop (default 0)

tools.name: get_widget
tools.description: Get a widget's values by packed component id: bounds, relative/original position, text, item, sprite, hidden state and children.

depth.description: How many levels of dynamic children to include (default 1, max 5)

tools.name: dump_interface
tools.description: Dump every component of an interface with positions/sizes/text. Call twice and diff the JSON to spot layout changes.

tools.name: list_interfaces
tools.description: List interface (group) ids currently loaded and visible, so you know what can be inspected.

tools.name: get_widget_at
tools.description: Find the deepest visible widget at a canvas pixel: its packed component id, bounds, text etc plus the parent chain. Use to identify what is at a spot on a screenshot.

tools.name: set_widget
tools.description: Live-edit a widget client-side and revalidate: move, resize, hide, retext, recolor etc. Great for prototyping interface layout changes before touching server code. Server scripts may overwrite the change on the next interface update.

componentId.description: Packed component id of the widget to modify

tools.name: get_client_state
tools.description: Get game state, canvas size, resized/fixed mode, mouse position, player world position/region, run energy, weight, camera yaw/pitch/zoom and whether a right-click menu is open.

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Local player skills: level, boosted level and xp per skill, plus total level. Hitpoints boosted level = current HP.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click at canvas coordinates by dispatching real mouse events.

tools.name: click_component
tools.description: Click the center of a widget resolved by packed component id. Fails if the widget is missing or hidden.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Move the mouse to canvas coordinates or a widget's center without clicking.

componentId.description: Packed component id to hover (used instead of x/y)

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Press at the source, drag through intermediate points, release at the target. Source/target are either packed component ids or canvas coordinates.

fromComponentId.description: Packed component id to drag from

fromChildIndex.description: Optional dynamic child index for the source

fromX.description: Source canvas x (used if fromComponentId absent)

toComponentId.description: Packed component id to drag to

toChildIndex.description: Optional dynamic child index for the target

toX.description: Target canvas x (used if toComponentId absent)

stepDelayMs.description: Delay between drag moves in ms (default 20)

tools.name: type_chat
tools.description: Type text into the game chatbox by dispatching key events, then press Enter to send. Works for :: commands.

text.description: Text to type into the chatbox, e.g. a chat message or a :: command

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a single key on the game canvas (e.g. ESCAPE to close an interface).

key.description: Single character, or ENTER, ESCAPE, SPACE, TAB, BACKSPACE, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, F1-F12

tools.name: walk_to
tools.description: Click the tile at world coordinates to walk there. Clicks the viewport when the tile is on screen, otherwise the minimap. Tile must be in the loaded scene.

tools.name: list_npcs
tools.description: List NPCs with id, index, name, combat level, actions, world location, distance, animation, facing, health (when visible) and canvas position, sorted by distance.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on NPC name

maxDistance.description: Only NPCs within this many tiles of the player

tools.name: list_players
tools.description: List players with name, combat level, world location, distance, animation, facing, health (when visible) and canvas position, sorted by distance. Local player is flagged isLocal.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on player name

maxDistance.description: Only players within this many tiles of the local player

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List scene objects (game, wall, decorative, ground) with id, name, actions, world position, face direction (orientation in jau 0-2047, degrees and compass) and size, sorted by distance.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on object name

maxDistance.description: Only objects within this many tiles of the player

tools.name: list_ground_items
tools.description: List items on the floor: itemId, name, quantity, world location and distance, sorted by distance. Use pickup_item to take one.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on item name

maxDistance.description: Only items within this many tiles of the player

tools.name: pickup_item
tools.description: Invoke Take on a ground item at world coordinates. Player walks to the tile and picks it up.

x.description: World x of the tile the item is on

tools.name: list_projectiles
tools.description: List projectiles currently in flight: id, remaining cycles, start scene position and target point/actor.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Read an item container by id: every slot with itemId, name and quantity. 93=inventory, 94=worn, 95=bank; server-made containers work too.

inventoryId.description: Item container id, e.g. 93 inventory, 94 worn equipment, 95 bank

includeEmpty.description: Include empty slots as itemId -1 (default false)

tools.name: list_inventories
tools.description: List all item containers currently loaded in the client: container id, slot count and non-empty item count. Use get_inventory for contents.

tools.name: interact_npc
tools.description: Invoke a cache-defined right-click option on an NPC (default Talk-to). Only sees options from the NPC definition; for server-added or runtime menu options use get_npc_menu + click_menu_option instead.

npcName.description: Case-insensitive NPC name substring; nearest match wins (used if npcIndex absent)

option.description: Right-click menu option to invoke, e.g. Talk-to, Trade, Attack (default Talk-to)

tools.name: get_npc_menu
tools.description: Hover an NPC and read its live right-click mini-menu: every entry including server-added quick options, top entry first (index 0 = default left-click). Follow with click_menu_option.

npcName.description: Case-insensitive NPC name substring; nearest match wins

tools.name: click_menu_option
tools.description: Click an entry of the currently built mini-menu (hover something first, e.g. via get_npc_menu or hover). Invokes the entry exactly as a right-click menu click would.

option.description: Case-insensitive substring of the menu option text, e.g. Vote, Trade, Quick-start

target.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of the entry target to disambiguate

tools.name: item_action
tools.description: Right-click an inventory item and click an option in ONE call - no screenshot needed. Finds the item slot, hovers it, invokes the matching menu entry (e.g. Drop). Inventory tab must be visible.

itemName.description: Case-insensitive item name substring (used if itemId absent)

option.description: Right-click option to invoke, e.g. Drop, Eat, Wield, Use, Bury

tools.name: interact_object
tools.description: Interact with a scene object in ONE call - no screenshot needed. Finds the nearest matching object, hovers it and clicks the option. e.g. nameFilter 'tree' + option 'Chop down'. list_objects shows available actions.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive object name substring; nearest match wins (used if objectId absent)

option.description: Menu option to click, e.g. Chop down, Mine, Bank, Open. Default: the object's first action

tools.name: interact_player
tools.description: Interact with another player in ONE call - no screenshot needed. Hovers the player and clicks the matching right-click option, e.g. Trade with.

playerName.description: Case-insensitive player name substring; nearest match wins

option.description: Menu option to click, e.g. Trade with, Follow, Challenge, Attack

tools.name: widget_action
tools.description: Right-click any widget and click a menu option in ONE call: hovers the widget, then invokes the matching mini-menu entry. Works for spells, prayers, equipment, buttons.

componentId.description: Packed component id of the widget

option.description: Case-insensitive substring of the menu option to invoke

tools.name: invoke_menu_action
tools.description: Low-level escape hatch: invoke client.menuAction with raw parameters. Use only when the higher-level interact tools cannot express the action (params visible in get_npc_menu entries or script history).

param0.description: Menu param0 (often slot or scene x)

param1.description: Menu param1 (often packed widget id or scene y)

type.description: MenuAction enum name, e.g. CC_OP, WIDGET_TARGET, GAME_OBJECT_FIRST_OPTION

identifier.description: Menu identifier (op index, npc index, object id...)

tools.name: get_dialogue
tools.description: Read the current dialogue state: NPC/player dialogue text and speaker, numbered options menu, message box, item dialog, or open chatbox input prompt.

tools.name: continue_dialogue
tools.description: Press space to advance the current dialogue and return the new dialogue state as soon as it changes.

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Choose a numbered dialogue option by pressing its number key and return the new dialogue state as soon as it changes.

option.description: Option number as shown by get_dialogue (1-based)

tools.name: enter_input
tools.description: Type a value into the open chatbox input (string or amount prompt) and press Enter, then return the new dialogue state.

text.description: Value to type: a string or a number depending on the prompt

tools.name: get_script_history
tools.description: Report clientscripts fired recently: per-script fire counts plus individual events with game tick, timestamp and root-script arguments.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 5000)

tools.name: get_var_history
tools.description: Report varbit, varp and varc changes in a recent window, in order, with old and new values, game tick and timestamp.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 5000)

type.description: Filter: varbit, varp, varcint or varcstr

tools.name: get_var
tools.description: Read the current value of a varbit, varp, varc int or varc string.

type.description: One of: varbit, varp, varcint, varcstr

tools.name: get_projectile_history
tools.description: Report projectiles launched recently: id, start position, slope/height values, cycles and target, one entry per projectile.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

tools.name: get_effect_history
tools.description: Report animations and graphics (spotanims) played by NPCs/players recently, with actor name, npc id, value and game tick.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

actorName.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the actor name

tools.name: get_chat_history
tools.description: Read chatbox messages received recently: type, sender, message, game tick and timestamp. Covers game messages, public/private chat etc (not NPC dialogue - use get_dialogue).

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 60000)

type.description: Filter by ChatMessageType name, e.g. GAMEMESSAGE, PUBLICCHAT, PRIVATECHAT, SPAM

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the sender name

tools.name: get_combat_history
tools.description: Report hitsplats applied recently: damage amount, hitsplat type, the actor hit, its remaining health ratio and game tick. Use this for max hit, accuracy and splash checks instead of watching damage numbers on screen.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

actorName.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the actor name

tools.name: get_xp_history
tools.description: Report experience gains recently: skill, xp gained, new total xp, level and boosted level, with game tick. Use to check xp per action against the expected rate.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 60000)

skill.description: Only this skill, e.g. ATTACK, WOODCUTTING

tools.name: get_container_history
tools.description: Report item container changes recently as per-item deltas (was, now, delta), so you can see exactly what was gained, consumed or dropped and on which tick. 93 inventory, 94 worn, 95 bank.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 60000)

tools.name: get_sound_history
tools.description: Report sound effects played recently: sound id, source actor, and for area sounds the scene position, with game tick.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Every recorded channel merged into one tick-ordered stream: vars, projectiles, effects, chat, combat, experience, containers and sounds. Scripts fire many times a second, so they are left out unless requested via channels. Read this to see what happened around an action, instead of correlating the per-channel history tools by hand.

sinceMs.description: Window in milliseconds looking back from now (default 10000)

channels.description: Only these channels: script, var, projectile, effect, chat, combat, experience, container, sound (default all but script)

fromTick.description: Only events on or after this game tick

toTick.description: Only events on or before this game tick

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Block until a game condition is met, checked every 100ms - returns the moment it happens. Use this after walk_to/interact/attack instead of taking screenshots or guessing delays. Returns met:false with current state on timeout.

condition.description: What to wait for: idle (player stopped animating/moving), at_tile (arrived at x/y), npc_dead (npcIndex/npcName), dialogue (any dialogue opened), interface_open / interface_closed (interfaceId), chat_message (textContains appeared)

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this long (default 10000, max 60000)

range.description: at_tile: max tiles away to count as arrived (default 1)

textContains.description: chat_message: case-insensitive substring to watch for
